Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Today, the matter is listed on the withdrawal
application (IA No.1/2026). By the said withdrawal
application, petitioner wants to withdraw the
present contempt petition on the assurance given
by respondent-contemnor-Apoorva Singh that she
would comply the order once the contempt petition
is withdrawn.
3. Permission to withdraw the contempt petition
is granted.
4. Accordingly, the contempt petition is dismissed
as withdrawn. However, liberty is given to the
petitioner to file fresh contempt petition as and
when the cause of action arises.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
02.09.2026 AK
